resolution.note: Captures for gh, codex mcp list, codex sandbox and codex exec; spec/receivers.json has no pending entry.

title: Record receiver captures for the modules KRN-12 lists as pending
body:
Outcome: each module listed with `pending` in spec/receivers.json gets KRN-12 evidence, a verbatim capture under test/fixtures read by a named test or a named test that drives the real receiver, and its entry drops `pending`.
Evidence: test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs lists the pending modules; recon found src/deliver/transport.ts tests use a hand-written gh stderr, src/flow/panel.ts and src/worker/acceptance.ts run a fake codex, src/worker/isolation.ts parses hand-written `codex mcp list --json`, and test/fixtures/codex/rust-v0.162.1.jsonl read by test/hosts/codex-usage.test.ts is synthetic, not captured.
Acceptance: `node --test test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs` passes with no entry naming this task; captures follow test/fixtures/README.md (redaction, provenance, no account state).
